description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the University of Jaffna, Sri Lanka, and the Board of Trustees of Southern Illinois University of the United States of America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Jaffna and the Board of Trustees of Southern Illinois University of the United States of America, with the objective of further strengthening the friendly relations between the two Countries by working towards achieving excellence in academic activities and advancing and disseminating knowledge. By entering into the proposed MoU, it is expected to foster collaboration in several areas such as engaging in joint research and educational activities, promoting international experience through the exchange of academic staff for research, lectures and discussions in all fields of study, encouraging the exchange of undergraduate and postgraduate students for learning, research, and internships, organizing joint symposiums, conferences and seminars and facilitating the exchange of information by linking the websites of the said two Universities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Jaffna, Sri Lanka, and the Board of Trustees of Southern Illinois University of the United States of America to be effective for a period of five (05) years from the date of signing, was approved by the Cabinet.
